nodes.borek.text.t: "Borek's woman drifts round the well like a lost soul. Her man went into the woods with the sheep and never came back. Talk to her, you've got the legs for walking."

nodes.borek_wrocil.text.t: Wrzosek pours two mugs and sets one in front of you without a word, which from him is as good as a medal. "He's back. Good. Half the village has told me already, but you're the first not to add that the ruins are haunted. Drink."

nodes.dlug.text.t: "Since you're running between me and the mill anyway, you can pop over to Ostromir as well. The merchant owes me for three barrels, and I haven't seen his wagon since autumn. Take the promissory note, get a receipt that he's had it, and come back. I'll pay."

nodes.dlug_oddany.text.t: Wrzosek holds the receipt up to the light, sniffs it and bites a corner of the bark. "Signature's real. Nobody faking it would scrawl like that." He wipes his paws and nods approvingly. "I owe you a debt of gratitude. Just don't count on me paying it out in beer."

nodes.oddanie.text.t: Wrzosek sniffs the bunch and grins for the first time today. "Smells like salvation. You've a good word from me, maybe even a beer. And if you're bored, someone's been poking about the Old Mill across the river at night. Ostap, our miller, is forever moaning about something."

nodes.plotka_ok.text.t: Wrzosek leans over the counter and lowers his voice so the whole room can hear. "For you, free of charge. In the woods past the watchtower there's a path walked only by those who don't want to be seen. Herbs grow there like weeds on a dung heap. Just don't say you had it from Wrzosek."

nodes.plotka_zle.text.t: "You've ears for listening, and a tongue good for nothing." Wrzosek goes back to his rag, but a drunk carter in the corner mumbles something about a path in the woods past the watchtower. Folk say herbs grow there. Enough to know where to look.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Wrzosek wipes a mug with the same rag he just ran over the table. "At the Wolf's Fang we welcome anyone with a coin or a tale. Best of all, both."

nodes.robota.options.#0.text.t: I'll see what I can do.

nodes.robota.text.t: "Do I need anything? My head's splitting after last night, that's what. In the woods past the watchtower there's a glade where herbs for just such mornings grow. Pick me some and bring them here. I'll pay as much as my conscience allows, which is little."

nodes.wiadomosc.text.t: Wrzosek hears he's to give back two mugs and says nothing for a long while. "Ostap only remembers debts. Other people's." After some thought he tops up your cup. "For the news."
